labels.text: mara's repair notes
some things can be mended.
From a bookbinder's workbench. Notes on old books, stubborn glue, and knowing when to leave a mark alone.
The blue notebook
7 October 2026
The cloth is worn through at the corners. Underneath, the board is still firm. I cut four small patches instead of replacing the cover.
Someone has written a grocery list on the last page. I left it there.
Încet, cu răbdare. Păstrez urmele pe care le-a lăsat timpul.
